best_drive_from_back.why: Liam Lawson gained 15 places from P22 in the 6th-fastest car.

best_strategy.why: Carlos Sainz's 3-stop race cost 1.6 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 21.9 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 31 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Liam Lawson, lap 9
overtake_of_race.why: Ryo Hirakawa passed Liam Lawson for P17 on lap 9 despite being +0.96 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

unluckiest.label: 10.0 points lost

smoothest.label: 0.262 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Franco Colapinto's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.262 s (1 sd).
